text:
anya: Quick heads-up — I ran a link-scan of /kb/model-onboarding yesterday and found 6 broken links (404) and 2 images returning 403. Dropping the paths below so owners can claim fixes.

sam: thanks — can you paste the exact list?

anya: sure — output from link-checker: 
- /kb/model-onboarding/quick-start -> 404 (old snippet path)
- /kb/model-onboarding/advanced -> 404 (broken anchor)
- /kb/model-onboarding/#runtime-config -> 404 (anchor moved)
- /kb/model-onboarding/gpu-tuning -> 404 (renamed)
- /kb/model-onboarding/img/diagram1.png -> 403 (cdn origin)
- /kb/model-onboarding/img/diagram2.png -> 403 (cdn origin)

chris: I own the runtime-config section, I can fix that anchor and update the local anchors. claim

maria: pinging infra to check the 403s, @kevin can you confirm if the CDN origin change last week caused this?

docsbot: link-checker run complete for /kb/model-onboarding (scan id 1748129000). Report: https://internal.reports/docs/link-checks/1748129000 — 6 broken links, 2 blocked images.

kevin: looking now. We did a limited origin rebind last Tue; possible the image bucket ACLs didn't propagate. I'll run a quick audit and purge caches if needed. ETA ~2h.

anya: thanks. For ownership: please reply with "claim" on the entry you want. I'll batch the small edits into a single PR to reduce churn. If nobody claims by EOD I'll assign to docs-rotations.

sam: claim the first two (/kb/model-onboarding/quick-start and /kb/model-onboarding/advanced) — I'll update redirects and the renamed paths.

chris: confirmed I claimed /kb/model-onboarding/#runtime-config — I'll add a short note in the section explaining the anchor mapping.

maria: infra will handle image ACLs, will post back when purge is done.

anya: quick note on PR content — please include a tiny changelog line and the scan id in the PR body. Also add frontmatter redirects when appropriate. Example snippet: 
```
---
redirect_from:
 - /kb/model-onboarding/old-snippet
---
```

sam: perfect — I'll include that.

docs-rotations: noted, will pick up any unclaimed items after EOD. :thumbsup:

kevin: origin ACL fixed and CDN purged for the affected paths. images should be accessible now, please verify.

anya: verified — images load for me. I'll open the combined PR with the 4 link edits and assign to sam/chris for review. Leaving the ticket open until merged. Thanks everyone :wave:

sam: thanks — will review once PR is up.

chris: thanks, will review too.

maria: closing infra loop here. If anything else pops up ping me.

anya: closing the thread when PR merged.
